I run projectcostestimator.com, an independent website cost calculator (we don't build sites). Two things for BaseHost, since your site says "BaseHost is Australia's managed IT partner. Microsoft 365, cyber security, cloud, voice and compliance support from senior engineers since 2004":

1. The calculator on your own site. The visitor prices their project on your page and the button sends them to your contact form; your name on it, your colours, no credit line, loads and clicks counted per day. Embed Pro is $29 a month for one domain, cancel any time.

2. A free listing here. People who finish an estimate can ask for quotes, and the request, with type, platform, budget band and deadline already filled in, goes to listed web design agencies that serve Australia. No commission, no contract, nothing billed for requests right now.

Both start from one two-minute form: https://projectcostestimator.com/for-agencies?ref=out-basehost

If it's not for you, reply "no" and I won't write again, or use this link and the system
stops on its own: https://projectcostestimator.com/api/unsubscribe?e=sales%40basehost.com.au&s=4770cf21d69e63be34013d902077e602

Florin Florea
founder, Project Cost Estimator
hello@projectcostestimator.com
